ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; predominantly low-intensity black pixels covering over 95% of the surface area with localized high-intensity white pixels restricted to barnacle clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid contiguous low-intensity dark area across both lobes; distinct high-contrast white circular pixel blobs distributed along the right fluke tip, right trailing edge, and mid-section of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 48 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular saw-toothed serrations along the left lobe trailing edge; right lobe exhibits lower-frequency but deeper jagged notches localized near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve originating from the median notch transitioning to a slight concavity toward the distal tips of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly visible high-contrast white circular pixel clusters (barnacles) densely packed on the right fluke tip and trailing edge, with a distinct triangular constellation of five clusters on the mid-left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two faint, nearly parallel horizontal linear pixel disruptions visible on the mid-lower quadrant of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant secondary fleshy protuberance and notch on the inner margin of the left lobe immediately adjacent to the primary median notch; extensive barnacle encrustation along the right lobe trailing margin.
